reference_host_profile_observed.cpu_model: Intel(R) Xeon(R) CPU @ 2.60GHz (Family 6, Model 106, Stepping 6, Ice Lake-SP)
reference_host_profile_observed.hypervisor: KVM (cpufreq sysfs not exposed; pin single-socket physical cores 0-23 via taskset/numactl)

execution_isolation_rules.numa_and_core_pinning: Run single-threaded benchmarks via `numactl --cpunodebind=0 --membind=0 taskset -c <physical_core>` avoiding sibling hyperthreads (cores 0..23 vs siblings 48..71)
execution_isolation_rules.aslr_control: Disable ASLR via `setarch $(uname -m) -R` to stabilize stack/heap page alignment across runs
execution_isolation_rules.environment_sanitization: Fixed `LC_ALL=C.UTF-8`, `TZ=UTC`, `RUST_BACKTRACE=0`, and identical directory path lengths for `RUSTFLAGS` / `--remap-path-prefix`
execution_isolation_rules.bare_metal_governor_when_available: Set `/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*/cpufreq/scaling_governor` to `performance`, disable turbo boost (`no_turbo=1`), and drop page cache only before cold-I/O tests

statistical_protocol.warmup_iterations: Minimum 3 full process warmup runs (or 500 ms in-process warmup in benchlib)
statistical_protocol.sample_size: Minimum N=30 process invocations for compile-time and CLI application workloads; minimum M=100 in-process iterations per invocation for microbenchmarks
statistical_protocol.hardware_counters: Record wall-clock ns (`CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW`), user/sys CPU time, max RSS (`ru_maxrss`), and `perf stat` counters (`instructions:u`, `cycles:u`, `branches:u`, `branch-misses:u`, `L1-dcache-load-misses:u`) when PMU access permits
summary_estimators: mean and sample standard deviation (for comparison only)
10,000-resample percentile bootstrap 95% confidence interval on median ratio (candidate / baseline)
statistical_protocol.hypothesis_and_noise_gate: Two-sided Mann-Whitney U test (alpha = 0.01) paired with a minimum effect-size threshold (> 1.0% instruction-count delta or > 1.5% wall-clock median delta when Normalized IQR < 2.0%). Flag any benchmark with Normalized IQR >= 3.0% as noisy and require re-run under stricter core isolation.

binary_size_accounting.primary_parity_metric: Sum of allocatable loadable code + read-only data (`.text + .rodata`) and total stripped image size (`strip --strip-debug`)
